description: This source file implements a command-line application that can act as a server or client for privileged file requests. It includes functionality for creating shared files, handling requests, and user interaction via console input.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A class representing a privileged request server that manages shared files, handles service requests, and logs activity.

methods.name: ParseOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine if the server mode is enabled and to extract the identifier.

methods.name: Server (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the server by creating a specified number of shared files and writing initial logs.

methods.name: Server (~destructor)
methods.description: Cleans up shared files and logs closure activity.

methods.name: Service
methods.description: Handles service requests by populating a container with file descriptors.
